text: benchmarks/runs/dna-1024.fa is the suite's normal DNA fixture at 1024 MiB: 24 records, 6 distinct bytes, made 2026-11-05 with -s 1024. On it, 8 threads, one run, create --dna at 80d74c0 takes 57.7 s and 1361 MiB peak RSS; with the occupancy-ranked encoder and its 46656 buckets, 47.9 s and 1539 MiB. The 10 MiB fixture never flushes a bucket to disk, so this is the smallest size that times the disk scratch.
